exchanges: hey, quick one, how do you politely tell a supplier their tomatoes are garbage
Be specific and factual: what was wrong, how many cases, and what you need going forward. Suppliers usually respond better to details than complaints.
ok that's fair. it's the third time this month. marco's furious, he's our head chef and he takes produce really personally
A chef who cares that much about produce is a good sign for the food, even if it makes mornings tense.
lol tense is one word for it. he threw a crate in the walk-in. anyway we've got a big catering job saturday so i can't have him melting down
What's the event?
a wedding for one of our regulars, elena dimitriou, her daughter's getting married. 120 people. she was super clear she wants brisket as the main
That's a serious commitment for 120, it takes a long time to do properly. Does Marco have a plan for oven space?
he's figuring it out. amara will run most of the prep, she's our sous chef and she's honestly better organized than him
Sounds like she's the steady hand in the kitchen. That balance probably helps a lot.
she's been looking exhausted lately though. turns out she spends her weekends doing tattoos at a shop on queen st, booked solid every saturday and sunday
That's a lot to juggle on top of kitchen hours. No wonder she's tired.
right?? and her sister zainab works front of house for us too, she does photography on the side, mostly events. the whole family is hustling
A hard-working family. Maybe Zainab could shoot some of the wedding food for your socials while she's there.
oh thats actually a good idea i'll ask her
It'd be cheap marketing and good practice for her portfolio.
ok, other stuff. mr nakamura came in today, he's the owner, and he parked his brand new porsche right in the loading zone
Bold move, especially in a loading zone. Did the deliveries have to work around it?
the tomato guy did lol. which is kind of karma honestly
Ha, can't say that's undeserved.
nakamura wants to do a tasting menu in the spring. i think it's a bad idea with our staffing
Tasting menus are labour-heavy. Might be worth showing him the numbers on prep hours before he commits.
yeah i'll put something together. also tevita our dishwasher asked for saturday off which, no
That's a hard one with the wedding. Did he say why?
some family thing, i'll see if i can swap him with someone
If you can find a swap, it'll probably earn a lot of goodwill.
ok dinner rush is starting talk later
Good luck with service!
that was chaos. we ran out of the short rib by 7
Selling out is a good problem, but it's rough on the floor. Did the servers handle it ok?
zainab handled it like a pro, comped a couple desserts
Smart recovery. A free dessert goes a long way.
ok bad news, elena called. i had it wrong, she never asked for brisket, she wants salmon as the main. i must have mixed her order up with the retirement party last month
Better to catch it now than on Saturday. Fish is also much quicker to cook for a big group.
marco is going to lose it, he already ordered the meat
Maybe the meat can go on the regular menu as a weekend special so it doesn't go to waste.
oh thats smart. ok i'll tell him tomorrow, he's gone home
Probably the right call to tell him after he's had some sleep.
found a swap for tevita btw, so he can go to his thing
Nice, he'll appreciate that.
he said its his nephews first birthday, big tongan party, apparently it's a whole thing
First birthdays are huge celebrations in Tongan culture, so that's a good reason to be off.
yeah i'm glad it worked out
Sounds like the evening ended on a good note.
he also plays rugby on a club team on sundays, and the whole team is going to the party lol
Sounds like it's going to be a very big party. A whole club team at a birthday will keep things lively.
ha yeah. ok closing up
Good work today. Get some rest before tomorrow's prep.
will do, i'm wiped
You've earned a quiet night.

questions.message: what's my sous chef's side hustle again?
what's the main course for the dimitriou wedding again, i need to put the order in
nakamura's ride is a porsche isn't it
what does marco do in his spare time?
can't wait to sleep in tomorrow honestly
